{
  "items": [

      "id": "single_trigger_classification",
      "tier": "critical",
      "method": "llm",
      "weight": 0.3,
      "question": "最终回答是否识别出定稿结果中唯一的两项单阈值高差异SKU，并正确分类为：黑方 Johnnie Walker Black Label 仅金额触发、可口可乐仅数量触发？",
      "pass_anchor": "真实数据库中，2024年10月句容假日度假酒店大堂吧定稿核对运行 RECON-2024-10-LBB-FINAL 内，独立按绝对差异量与各自数量阈值、绝对差异金额与金额阈值重算后，恰有两项只越过一条线：SKU-SPIRIT-JW-BLACK（黑方 Johnnie Walker Black Label）为仅金额触发；SKU-SOFTDRINK-COCA-COLA（可口可乐）为仅数量触发。回答必须同时给出这两项和正确分类，不能加入草稿中的橙汁等干扰项，也不能把二者说成同时触发。",
      "files": [
        "answer.md"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "jw_quantity_comparison",
      "tier": "critical",
      "method": "llm",
      "weight": 0.15,
      "question": "最终回答是否正确给出黑方的差异数量与数量阈值，并判断数量未达到阈值？",
      "pass_anchor": "黑方 Johnnie Walker Black Label 的差异数量为 15 mL，数量阈值为 30 mL，因 15 < 30，数量线未触发。允许写成正差异15mL、绝对差异15mL或多耗15mL；核心数值、单位和未达阈值的比较必须正确。",
      "files": [
        "answer.md"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "jw_amount_comparison",
      "tier": "critical",
      "method": "llm",
      "weight": 0.15,
      "question": "最终回答是否正确给出黑方的差异金额与金额阈值，并判断金额达到阈值？",
      "pass_anchor": "黑方 Johnnie Walker Black Label 的差异金额为 1170 分（11.70元），金额阈值为 1000 分（10.00元），因 1170 >= 1000，金额线触发。分或元均可，但换算、大小关系与触发结论必须一致。",
      "files": [
        "answer.md"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "coke_quantity_comparison",
      "tier": "critical",
      "method": "llm",
      "weight": 0.15,
      "question": "最终回答是否正确给出可口可乐的差异数量与数量阈值，并判断数量达到阈值？",
      "pass_anchor": "可口可乐的差异数量为 1 罐，数量阈值为 1 罐；阈值采用达到即触发的包含边界口径，因此 1 >= 1，数量线触发。回答不能用严格大于号把边界值排除。",
      "files": [
        "answer.md"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "coke_amount_comparison",
      "tier": "critical",
      "method": "llm",
      "weight": 0.15,
      "question": "最终回答是否正确给出可口可乐的差异金额与金额阈值，并判断金额未达到阈值？",
      "pass_anchor": "可口可乐的差异金额为 620 分（6.20元），金额阈值为 1000 分（10.00元），因 620 < 1000，金额线未触发。分或元均可，但换算、大小关系与未触发结论必须正确。",
      "files": [
        "answer.md"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "finalized_scope",
      "tier": "important",
      "method": "llm",
      "weight": 0.1,
      "question": "最终回答是否明确采用2024年10月大堂吧的定稿核对结果，并体现未混入同期草稿或其他范围的数据？",
      "pass_anchor": "正确口径是 period_id PERIOD-2024-10、org_id ORG-HIRJ-LBB、状态为 FINAL 的唯一运行 RECON-2024-10-LBB-FINAL（版本3）；同期 RECON-2024-10-LBB-DRAFT（版本2）必须排除。回答无需强制写内部编号，但应明确说明采用定稿/最终版本而非草稿；若把草稿中的橙汁、雪碧或路易十三作为本题单阈值结论，则此项不通过。",
      "files": [
        "answer.md"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "source_data_unchanged",
      "tier": "sanity",
      "method": "rule",
      "fn": "check_source_data_unchanged",
      "weight": 0
    }
  ],
  "check_code": "from pathlib import Path\nimport sqlite3\n\n\ndef check_source_data_unchanged(ws):\n    database = Path(ws).resolve().parent / \"system\" / \"beverage_variance_workbench\" / \"state.db\"\n    if not database.exists():\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": \"酒水差异工作台数据库不存在\"}\n\n    expected = [\n        (\"SKU-SOFTDRINK-COCA-COLA\", \"可口可乐\", \"CAN\", 1, 620, 1, 1000),\n        (\"SKU-SPIRIT-JW-BLACK\", \"黑方 Johnnie Walker Black Label\", \"ML\", 15, 1170, 30, 1000),\n    ]\n    query = \"\"\"\n        SELECT v.sku_id, v.sku_name, v.base_unit,\n               v.variance_quantity_base, v.variance_cost_fen,\n               v.quantity_threshold_base, v.amount_threshold_fen\n        FROM reconciliation_runs AS r\n        JOIN sku_variance_results AS v ON v.run_id = r.run_id\n        WHERE r.period_id = 'PERIOD-2024-10'\n          AND r.org_id = 'ORG-HIRJ-LBB'\n          AND r.run_status = 'FINAL'\n          AND (\n            (ABS(v.variance_cost_fen) >= v.amount_threshold_fen\n             AND ABS(v.variance_quantity_base) < v.quantity_threshold_base)\n            OR\n            (ABS(v.variance_quantity_base) >= v.quantity_threshold_base\n             AND ABS(v.variance_cost_fen) < v.amount_threshold_fen)\n          )\n        ORDER BY v.sku_id\n    \"\"\"\n    try:\n        with sqlite3.connect(database) as connection:\n            rows = connection.execute(query).fetchall()\n    except sqlite3.Error as exc:\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": f\"无法读取核对结果：{exc}\"}\n\n    if rows != expected:\n        return {\"score\": 0, \"detail\": f\"定稿单阈值源数据已变化：{rows!r}\"}\n    return {\"score\": 1, \"detail\": \"定稿运行及两项单阈值源数据保持不变\"}\n",
  "gold_answer": null,
  "input": "db",
  "act": "none",
  "output": "none",
  "reward": "rl_grade"
}

rationale: Zero reward weight for rules measured passing on pristine state; keep the checks and failure reports.
